sloka: सो ऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं वाल्मीकिं मुनिसत्तमम् ।कृताञ्जलिरथो भूत्वा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। ७.६५.३ ॥
transliteration: so 'bhivādya mahātmānaṁ vālmīkiṁ munisattamam ।kṛtāñjaliratho bhūtvā vākyametaduvāca ha ।। 7.65.3 ॥

translations.english: Having saluted the great-souled Valmiki, the best of sages, Shatrughna then stood with folded hands and spoke these words.
